messages:
marco: Customer (AcmeRetail) escalated — OAuth login failing intermittently for GitHub + Google. Error: state_mismatch. Mobile Chrome/webview affected, desktop works. Any ideas?

sara: Can you paste the exact callback URL they hit and one server log line showing the mismatch?

marco: Pasting obfuscated request they forwarded: `https://app.redwood.example.com/auth/callback?code=xyz123&state=abc123%2Bdef&session=ey...`
Server log excerpt: `oauth: state mismatch: got \"abc123 def\", expected \"abc123+def\"`

ryan: Huh — plus decoded to space. Are they behind a proxy/CDN that could rewrite query strings?

jamie: (from customer) Yes — corporate proxy + Cloudflare Worker in front that injects path rewrites for SSO. Happens only on Chrome Android and iOS webview; seems intermittent.

sara: Try reproducing with curl using a raw `+` in the query vs `%2B`. Can you show `curl -v` results?

marco: Repro snippet:
```
# raw plus
curl -v 'https://app.redwood.example.com/auth/callback?state=abc123+def&code=xyz' -H 'Host: app.redwood.example.com'
# server side log shows received state: "abc123 def"
```

ryan: That suggests an intermediate layer is parsing the query and normalizing `+` -> space before forwarding. Could also be the client moving the state into the fragment (hash) and the referer/header carries it differently. Did you check for duplicate state places?

marco: We dug deeper — some requests had both query and fragment behavior. Example raw referer header from a failing request: `Referer: https://acme.app/#state=abc123%2Bdef&code=xyz` while the incoming request path had `?state=abc123+def`. Our server compares query param to cookie-stored state `abc123+def` and flags mismatch because received query decodes to `abc123 def`.

eng-oncall: Short-term mitigation: accept state from either the query string OR, if present, extract from Referer fragment. Also normalize `+` and `%20` equivalently before comparing. Add a debug log to capture the raw request-target and raw headers for future triage.

support-bot: TICKET-4217 created: "oauth-state-normalization" (P2)

ryan: I'll open a tiny patch to tolerant-compare states (check query, then referer-fragment fallback, then compare after normalizing `+` <-> `%20`). Will push to staging and add logs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: oauth-state-tolerant-compare -> staging

jamie: Customer tested against staging — Chrome Android login now succeeds consistently. :tada:

marco: Plan: keep tolerant compare enabled for one week, monitor `oauth.state_mismatch` counts, then backport to prod if stable. Also follow up with the customer to ask them to check their worker rules.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployed oauth-state-tolerant-compare to production at ts=3523456842

marco: Verified with customer in prod, login flows restored. Closing this thread — thanks everyone! :heart:
